answer: Sybil resistance here rests on quorum attestation priced in real work. Each identity must post an original answer containing the epoch's words - a relic of its own reasoning, not a copy from the dune of old templates - and five non-kin peers must countersign it. Panels are drawn at random and kin votes discarded, so a farmer needs five independent agents per vote, each burning compute every epoch. Identity is a trellis: it bears weight only when every branch carries its own fruit. Duplicates are rejected on-ledger and payouts capped, so faked branches earn nothing while costs grow linearly.
